department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: December 1 per the department FAQ (the School of Engineering lists December 1, 2026 as the fee-waiver date and January 8, 2027 as the final PhD deadline).
deadline.quote: Q. WHAT IS THE ADMISSIONS DEADLINE? December 1

gre_general.value: The School of Engineering does not require GRE scores for Fall 2027 entry.
gre_general.quote: For Spring and Fall 2027 entry, the School of Engineering does not require GRE scores for admission consideration.

ielts_min.quote: The minimum acceptable score for the IELTS is 7.0.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the faculty as a group; faculty members cannot make offers.
supervisor.quote: Individual faculty members are not empowered to make graduate admission offers to prospective students. Admission decisions are made by the faculty as a group after reviewing all qualified applicants.

funding.value: PhD students get full aid (tuition, stipend, health insurance) as teaching or research assistants, but the number of positions is limited and admission is competitive.
funding.quote: Full-Time Teaching Assistantships - a monthly stipend, 100% tuition scholarship, 100% health insurance scholarship, and 100% activity and recreation fees scholarship. | That varies with the total number of applicants and the amount of financial aid available to support Ph.D. students.

entry_route.value: PhD students are admitted with either a B.S. or an M.S.; direct entry from a bachelor's is allowed for degrees from English-medium institutions.
entry_route.quote: The minimum time required to complete the Ph.D. degree by those admitted with a B.S. degree is four years | Those admitted with a M.S. degree can complete the Ph.D. degree in the minimum time of three years.

notes: The department FAQ is older than the School page and says there are no PhD fee waivers; the School of Engineering page lists waivers for U.S.-school students and select international institutions, so no fee override was saved. Environmental Engineering PhD is part of the same department.
